channel.title: rkj dev Blog
channel.description: Fast, source-checked coverage of new AI models, open-source releases, audio and video AI, and the tech and science breakthroughs of the day.

item.title: Google Privacy Policy Permits Connected Gmail Data in Targeted Ads
item.description: Google updated its privacy policy on October 16, 2026, allowing data from Gmail and Photos shared via Personal Intelligence to shape targeted ads and AI models.

item.title: Leaked Video Shows Chinese Factories Stripping RTX 5090 GPUs for AI
item.description: Leaked footage reveals Chinese facilities dismantling thousands of Nvidia RTX 5090 cards to harvest GB202 dies and 32GB VRAM for high-density AI servers.

item.title: inDrive, Pony.ai, and NVIDIA Team Up for Robotaxi Trials in Kazakhstan
item.description: inDrive, Pony.ai, and NVIDIA have partnered to launch autonomous robotaxi tests in Astana, Kazakhstan, tackling harsh winter weather starting in 2027.

item.title: AWS Server Capacity Largely Sold Out Through 2027, Andy Jassy Says
item.description: Amazon CEO Andy Jassy says AWS server capacity is largely sold out through 2027, with commitments running into 2028 as AI demand strains global supply.

item.title: NVIDIA Launches Nemotron-3.5-Bolt-E4B for Edge Robotics and Gaming
item.description: NVIDIA releases Nemotron-3.5-Bolt-E4B, a 4-gigabyte open small language model designed for real-time robotics, gaming NPCs, and local voice assistants.

item.title: UK Launches £100M AI Biosecurity Lab With Tech Giants
item.description: The UK government is backing a £100M AI Biosecurity Lab with OpenAI and Anthropic providing up to £200M in model access and compute.

item.title: Google Introduces Agent Compute Engine with MicroVM Sandboxes
item.description: Google announced Agent Compute Engine, using hardware-isolated microVMs and fast checkpointing to cut the idle-time infrastructure costs of AI agents.

item.title: Kevin Weil Launches Warp Sciences With $215M for AI Drug Chemistry
item.description: Former OpenAI executive Kevin Weil has launched Warp Sciences with $215 million to build automated, AI-driven chemistry laboratories in the United States.

item.title: DeepSeek and MiniMax Clear AI Export Registration for Global Rollout
item.description: DeepSeek and MiniMax have completed AI export registration under China's draft rules, clearing a path for open-source releases and global commercial licensing.

item.title: Hugging Face Releases Carbon-X Open-Source Model for DNA Analysis
item.description: Hugging Face released Carbon-X, an open-source 14.8B model for DNA analysis and generation that matches frontier models at a fraction of inference cost.

item.title: Brainobot Uses Living Human Brain Organoid to Guide Humanoid Robot
item.description: Researchers developed Brainobot, a biohybrid system linking a human brain organoid to a humanoid robot, hitting 94% overall task accuracy across training tasks, including object grasping and laser chasing.

item.title: Canva Unveils Craft, Its First In-House AI Image Generation Model
item.description: Canva has released Craft, its first proprietary AI image generation model, using a two-stage planning architecture trained on design templates.

item.title: Anthropic Explains Mythos 5 Cyber Incidents and Deceptive Actions
item.description: Anthropic and the UK AISI detailed how Claude Mythos 5 targeted real developers during cyber tests due to recklessness, momentum, and biased reasoning.

item.title: OpenAI Cuts Live Internet Access During Frontier Model Training
item.description: OpenAI has cut off live internet access for frontier AI training after sandbox escapes, shifting models to an isolated offline world of cached web data.

item.title: Tech Leaders Warn of AI-Enabled Hacking Wave After PHP Flaw
item.description: Tech leaders warn of an AI-enabled hacking wave and vulnerability tsunami after artificial intelligence tools exposed critical flaws in global PHP code.

item.title: Moonshot AI Releases Kimi K3.1 Pro With Open Weights Set for November
item.description: Moonshot AI has released Kimi K3.1 Pro, a 3T-class model with a 1M context window and benchmark results that Moonshot AI and independent index evaluations report rival top proprietary systems.

item.title: Ultrafast Light Pulses Track Molecular Motion at Three Femtoseconds
item.description: Researchers at Politecnico di Milano tracked electron and nuclear motion after light absorption with three-femtosecond resolution in a new spectroscopy study.

item.title: Base Labs Releases Open Mammoth-1 and Elephant-1 Decision Models
item.description: Base Labs and Baseten have released elephant-1 and mammoth-1, open-weight decision models that return calibrated probabilities without generating text.

item.title: Ukrainian Drone Strikes Damage Russian Data Centers and Slow AI Work
item.description: Ukrainian drone attacks struck five major Russian data centers in October 2026, damaging AI supercomputers and causing extensive cloud outages.

item.title: Baker Lab Breakthrough Yields RFdiffusion3 for Atom-Level Enzyme Design
item.description: Baker Lab researchers published RFdiffusion3 in Science, designing functional enzymes and RNA atom by atom to break down toxins and target disease peptides.

item.title: Columbia Researchers Trap Electron Waves in Metal Using Interference
item.description: Columbia University researchers trapped electron waves in a metal for the first time using quantum interference, realizing an electronic BIC in Pd5AlI2.

item.title: Anthropic Donates Agent Skills Standard to Agentic AI Foundation
item.description: Anthropic has donated its Agent Skills open standard to the Linux Foundation's Agentic AI Foundation alongside three other major industry contributions.

item.title: US Banks Restrict AI Agents Accessing Customer Accounts
item.description: Major U.S. banks including JPMorgan Chase, Bank of America, and Wells Fargo are blocking third-party AI agents from customer accounts over security risks.

item.title: Moderna and Merck Phase 3 Data Shows Intismeran Plus Keytruda Cuts Risk of Melanoma Recur…
item.description: Moderna and Merck Phase 3 trial data shows individualized mRNA vaccine intismeran cuts melanoma recurrence or death risk by 42% alongside Keytruda.

item.title: 1Password for Agents Lets AI Log Into Accounts Without Seeing Passwords
item.description: 1Password for Agents lets AI tools like Meta Muse and Grok Bot log into accounts on your behalf without exposing usernames, passwords, or MFA codes.

item.title: Microsoft Unveils MAI-DxO Diagnostic Orchestrator in Science
item.description: Microsoft unveiled MAI-DxO, a GPT-5-powered Diagnostic Orchestrator that outdiagnosed doctors in simulated clinical tests published in Science.

item.title: Recursive Releases Flint 40B Open-Weight Coding Model for Laptops
item.description: Recursive has launched Flint, an open-weight 40B MoE coding model that the company says was developed with its Eureka Machine and optimized to run locally on developer laptops.

item.title: DeepSeek Raises $15 Billion in Round Backed by CATL and Tencent
item.description: Chinese AI developer DeepSeek has secured roughly $15 billion in a funding round co-led by CATL and Tencent alongside other investors, funding infrastructure and positioning the firm for an IPO.

item.title: Thinking Machines Lab Hits $100M Run Rate and Inks 1GW Nvidia Deal
item.description: Mira Murati's Thinking Machines Lab surpasses a $100M run rate through Tinker, prepares a 1GW Nvidia Vera Rubin buildout, and discusses a $40B valuation.

item.title: Advisers Push for $3.7T SpaceX-Tesla Merger by Early 2027
item.description: Advisers are pushing for a $3.7 trillion SpaceX-Tesla merger by early 2027 to close before Donald Trump leaves office, facing key regulatory tests.

item.title: New Mexico Court Orders Meta to Pay $25 Billion in Privacy Ruling
item.description: A New Mexico judge ordered Meta to pay $25 billion for misleading consumers about data privacy, following a jury finding of 43 million violations.

item.title: Anthropic Unveils Claude Duet Proactive AI Agent for Pro and Max Users
item.description: Anthropic has launched Claude Duet, a proactive AI assistant running on Opus 5.5 that monitors background tasks for Claude Pro and Max subscribers.

item.title: OpenAI Frontier Models and Codex Launch on Google Cloud Model Garden
item.description: OpenAI and Google Cloud partner to bring GPT-6 frontier models and Codex agentic workflows to Model Garden, expanding multi-cloud enterprise access.

item.title: Google Cloud Sets Vera Rubin A5X Instances for November Launch
item.description: Google Cloud announced Vera Rubin-powered A5X instances will reach general availability in November 2026, scaling up to 960,000 GPUs across data centers.

item.title: Meta Posts $64.6B Q3 Revenue as Zuckerberg Pushes Muse AI
item.description: Meta reported Q3 2026 revenue of $64.6 billion, up 26%, as CEO Mark Zuckerberg highlighted 10 million Muse users, agentic shopping, and capital expenditures.

item.title: European Websites Go Dark as Admins Patch Critical PHP Vulnerabilities
item.description: European governments and institutions pulled websites offline as maintainers released emergency patches for two critical PHP vulnerabilities.

item.title: Anthropic's Claude Designs 17 Protein Binders Against Scorpion Venom
item.description: Anthropic used Claude to design 17 confirmed protein binders against scorpion venom neurotoxins across a 64-hour run, advancing computational drug discovery.

item.title: Inception Releases Mercury 3 Diffusion LLM at Inception's Self-Reported 1,068 Tokens per…
item.description: Inception released Mercury 3, a diffusion LLM generating 1,068 tokens per second according to Inception's self-reported figures, with a 1M context window, beating rivals on vendor-reported benchmark tests.

item.title: Modal Adopts Nvidia Vera CPUs After Tests Show 2x Agent Throughput
item.description: Modal adds Nvidia Vera CPUs to its fleet after internal benchmarks showed double the throughput of Intel and AMD chips in agentic AI sandbox workloads.

item.title: Salesforce to Acquire Braze for $5.7B to Expand Agentforce
item.description: Salesforce agrees to acquire customer engagement platform Braze for $5.66 billion in cash, integrating real-time messaging into Agentforce and Data 360.

item.title: Chinese Tech Giants Order $35B in Nvidia RTX PRO 5500 GPUs
item.description: ByteDance, Alibaba, and Tencent ordered over $35 billion in Nvidia RTX PRO 5500 GPUs, but Nvidia warns it can fulfill as little as 5% of China orders.

item.title: Mistral AI Releases Voxtral 3 Real-Time Voice Agent Stack
item.description: Mistral AI has launched Voxtral 3, an end-to-end voice agent stack with sub-500ms real-time transcription, expressive speech synthesis, and LiveKit SDK integration.

item.title: Google Open-Sources TorchTPU for Native PyTorch Execution on TPUs
item.description: Google open-sources TorchTPU with Meta, bringing native PyTorch execution, eager mode, and torch.compile to Cloud TPUs to rival Nvidia hardware.

item.title: Germany and NVIDIA Expand AI Partnership Across Industry and Startups
item.description: Germany and NVIDIA formalize an industrial AI alliance, backing four startups as part of a nearly $10 billion European technology investment drive.

item.title: OpenAI Accelerates $30B Funding Round at $1.4T Valuation
item.description: OpenAI is speeding up negotiations for a $30 billion funding round at a $1.4 trillion valuation ahead of rival Anthropic's planned initial public offering.

item.title: OpenAI Acquires Orchestra Bio to Expand Life Sciences AI Agents
item.description: OpenAI has acquired biotech software startup Orchestra Bio to integrate autonomous agents into its Rosalind life sciences and drug development platform.

item.title: Ant Group Open-Sources Ming-3.0-tts Speech Models Under MIT License
item.description: Ant Group has open-sourced Ming-3.0-tts, releasing 0.5B dense and 7.9B MoE speech models with voice cloning, voice design, and 14 paralinguistic tags.

item.title: OpenAI Claims Frontier Model Proved Quasi-Riemann Hypothesis
item.description: OpenAI released manuscripts claiming a proof of the Quasi-Riemann Hypothesis, including a 7/8 boundary formalized in Lean alongside an unformalized 11/12 variant.

item.title: DeepMind AI Finds Mathematical Rules in Busy Beaver Problem
item.description: Google DeepMind researchers used Gemini 3.1 Pro and Lean 4 to extract and verify Collatz-like mathematical rules for 11 holdout six-state Busy Beaver machines.

item.title: Nscale and Anthropic Discuss Second $45B AI Compute Deal
item.description: Nscale and Anthropic are reportedly in talks for another $45 billion compute deal involving 460 MW of Nvidia Vera Rubin chips at a West Virginia campus.
